objective: One real ScriptTask Run on the verified repair Native-3 Agent, reusing its unique Script/Task/Execution to cover the Script-specific P11 and P17 gaps without creating any other business resource.

canonical_cases.P11-03: Observe actual Run button loading/disabled behavior during exactly one click/confirm; if the network is too fast to observe it, leave that dimension PARTIAL and do not rerun.
canonical_cases.P11-05: Script slice only; do not claim Command or Application coverage.
canonical_cases.P11-06: Actual non-secret parameter, environment, working directory, and RunUser behavior through real agent execution.
canonical_cases.P17P18-02: Use the new live ScriptTask name plus real TaskID/NodeID/ExecutionID as q search terms.
canonical_cases.P17P18-06: Follow Task history → Execution detail → Task/Node links → Node execution history using the same exact IDs.
canonical_cases.P17P18-07: Validate real ScriptTask detail metadata (Task/Script revision, Node, manual trigger, offline/synced, exit code, duration); note the current UI source shows Task revision but not Script revision.
canonical_cases.P17P18-15: Compare ScriptTask’s immutable task_revision/script_id/script_revision to Task/Script revision APIs and the visible Task revision. No Script revision UI claim if it is not rendered.

target.selection: Exactly one node target by Node ID; no group or label target.
target.freshness: Prior online/synced and owner evidence is from 2026-10-10 06:11Z; it is historical only. Before creating anything, fresh GET and process ownership readback must confirm same Node/Agent, online+synced, repair binary SHA d55dc5cd… and root-UID Agent, exact cgroup/unit/config-path guard. If any identity/owner/status differs, stop before writes.

script.content: printf only the allowlisted QA_MARKER, NODESTEER_PARAM_QA_PARAM, PWD and id -u fields; sleep 3 seconds; no file or service changes.

fixture_definition.run_ui_parameter: A unique non-secret QA value entered in the Task Run form; no credential or secret parameter.

actual_user_path.path: Open Scripts → New; enter the minimal shell body, unique non-secret marker, QA_PARAM string parameter, /tmp working directory, run user nobody, timeout 15; save once.
Open Tasks → New; choose Script, select the just-created Script, set exact Node target, same required QA_PARAM, timeout 15, retry 0, online-required, enabled; do not configure a Schedule; save once.
Open the new Task detail, confirm Script link/target/revision and no schedule; open Run, enter QA_PARAM, open confirmation dialog, click confirm exactly once.

Observe the one POST /api/tasks/{taskID}/run (status/count/ID only). Before click, arm a local DOM MutationObserver on the Run button; record any real disabled/loading label transition during the request. Do not throttle or intercept network; if the state is too brief to observe, mark P11-03 PARTIAL.

From the returned Execution ID, poll only this execution until terminal (bounded 20s); record PENDING/RUNNING/SUCCESS or failure transitions observed, with same-ID API checks and UI page route. Script sleeps 3s to make real RUNNING observation feasible; no proxy hold.

On Task detail and Execution detail, traverse exact links to Script, Task, Node, Execution history and back; test q search by unique Task name, Task ID, Node ID, Execution ID; compare exact UI IDs to API results.

Read exact Task, Script, Script revision 1 and Execution APIs; compare task_revision=Task.revision, script_id=Task.script_id, script_revision=Script.revision=1, Script SHA, and UI-visible fields. Read only selected stdout lines in memory; store allowed values plus stdout byte count/SHA, not raw logs.

expected_real_oracles.script_revision: New Script starts at revision 1; its API SHA-256 equals the local expected body SHA-256 and GET /api/scripts/{id}/revisions/1 content hash.
expected_real_oracles.task_revision: New ScriptTask starts at revision 1; Execution task_revision equals it.
expected_real_oracles.execution_script_pin: Execution script_id equals Task script_id; script_revision equals Script revision 1.
expected_real_oracles.run_effect: Single Execution reaches SUCCESS/exit_code 0; stdout contains exactly the unique allowed QA_MARKER, supplied QA_PARAM, PWD=/tmp, RUN_UID=65534; API and detail UI agree on the same Execution ID, Task ID, Node ID, status, Task revision, trigger=manual, offline=false, synced=true, exit code and duration.
expected_real_oracles.ui_links: Task’s Script link and Execution-history link, Execution’s Task/Node links, and Node’s Execution link all resolve to the exact new IDs.
expected_real_oracles.dedup: Exactly one UI confirmation and one POST; GET /api/executions?task_id=<newTaskID> has exactly one row; no second attempt under any condition.

prewrite_guards: Dedicated private auth only; first login token must be written to a unique /tmp mode-0700 directory file mode 0600 before any browser eval. Never put token/credentials in argv, stdout, workspace evidence or shared session; on any UI injection error, the token file remains available for same-token API logout and /me=401.
Freshly verify Node/Agent identity, process PID/startticks/UID/argv config path only/exe SHA/cgroup/unit and online+synced; never stop/restart/alter the service.
Fresh GET /api/scripts, /api/tasks, /api/schedules and verify generated unique Script/Task names absent, no schedule references the new Task, and no pending/running execution for it.
Confirm target is root-owned repair Agent; this is required for Script.run_user=nobody to prove a real UID change. Do not infer UID switch from a nonroot child.
No primary :8080, no other Node, no global config, no proxy, no injected hold, no source changes.
cleanup_dependencies: Preserve the exact terminal Execution and audit history for evidence.
Delete only the new Task first; verify its GET returns 404 and it disappears from Task list. Ensure no Schedule exists.
Only after Task reference is gone, delete only the new Script; verify GET returns 404 and it disappears from Script list. ScriptManager rejects deletion while any Task references it.
Verify the historical Execution remains GET 200 with its ID/revisions/status/output byte count/SHA; verify target Node remains online+synced and no unrelated resource count/identity changed.

Logout the dedicated token through API and verify same-token /api/me=401, then close only the dedicated browser session and remove the profile after UID/mode/inode guard. Preserve private token only until logout verification, then unlink it.
known_limits: Current Execution detail UI source displays Task revision but not Script revision; P17P18-15 may remain PARTIAL for Script revision UI until the unified product repair is applied.
P11-05 coverage from this plan is Script only; Command and Application dimensions remain unchanged.
If RUN button loading/disabled transition is not observed during the one real API request, do not add artificial delay or a second Run; keep P11-03 partial.
No existing Task/Script can be edited or used to avoid unique fixture creation; all fixtures must be new and exact-cleaned.
